retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
CLOUD MISCONFIGURATION

DESCRIPTION:
Cloud misconfiguration occurs when cloud resources are deployed with insecure settings, excessive permissions, public exposure, or improper access controls. These weaknesses can expose sensitive data, enable unauthorized access, and facilitate further attacks.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1078 | Valid Accounts

INDICATORS:
- Publicly accessible storage buckets
- Excessive IAM permissions
- Exposed management interfaces
- Unrestricted security groups
- Public database endpoints

DETECTION RULES:
- Public storage buckets
- Excessive permissions
- Unauthorized cloud access

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Cloud storage
- Virtual machines
- Databases
- Cloud identities
title: CLOUD MISCONFIGURATION
